verdicts.note: Independent rule specifying capitalization for scientific classification ranks down to genus level.
Restates A5, which already specifies writing common names in roman type; G-4.
Describes typical practice with 'usually' rather than setting a strict requirement; G-5.
Specifies the required placement of the authority name after the first mention of the species.
Specifies enclosing authority name and date in parentheses when a species is transferred to another genus.
Independent rule specifying roman type for botanical rank abbreviations below species level.
Candidate covering the same sentence as C6; G-4.
Specifies that no word should follow the rank abbreviation when the variety or subspecies is unspecified.
Prohibits using the abbreviation 'subsp.' in animal subspecies names.
